m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-00.question: For every order status, what are the low, high, and mean totals?
m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-00.reference_sql: SELECT q020.status AS lifecycle, MIN(q020.total_amount) AS low_total, MAX(q020.total_amount) AS high_total, AVG(q020.total_amount) AS mean_total FROM orders AS q020 GROUP BY q020.status ORDER BY q020.status

m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-01.question: How do payment counts and sums break down by order currency?
m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-01.reference_sql: SELECT q021_o.currency AS currency_code, COUNT(q021_p.id) AS payment_rows, SUM(q021_p.amount) AS payment_sum FROM orders AS q021_o JOIN payments AS q021_p ON q021_p.order_id = q021_o.id GROUP BY q021_o.currency ORDER BY q021_o.currency

m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-02.question: For each catalog category, what are the mean and maximum prices?
m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-02.reference_sql: SELECT q022.category AS category_name, AVG(q022.unit_price) AS mean_price, MAX(q022.unit_price) AS peak_price FROM products AS q022 GROUP BY q022.category ORDER BY q022.category

m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-03.question: How many returns and how much value occur for each return reason?
m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-03.reference_sql: SELECT q023.reason AS reason_code, COUNT(q023.id) AS return_rows, SUM(q023.amount) AS return_sum FROM refunds AS q023 GROUP BY q023.reason ORDER BY q023.reason

m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-04.question: For each representative, summarize order count and subtotal value.
m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-04.reference_sql: SELECT q024_s.id AS representative_key, COUNT(q024_o.id) AS order_rows, SUM(q024_o.subtotal) AS subtotal_sum FROM sales_representatives AS q024_s JOIN orders AS q024_o ON q024_o.sales_rep_id = q024_s.id GROUP BY q024_s.id ORDER BY q024_s.id

m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-05.question: How does line quantity and extended value group by product key?
m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-05.reference_sql: SELECT q025.product_id AS product_key, SUM(q025.quantity) AS unit_sum, SUM(q025.quantity * q025.unit_price) AS extended_sum FROM order_items AS q025 GROUP BY q025.product_id ORDER BY q025.product_id

m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-06.question: For each currency, what is the mean discount and mean subtotal?
m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-06.reference_sql: SELECT q026.currency AS currency_code, AVG(q026.discount_amount) AS mean_discount, AVG(q026.subtotal) AS mean_subtotal FROM orders AS q026 GROUP BY q026.currency ORDER BY q026.currency

m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-07.question: How many customer rows belong to each region key?
m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-07.reference_sql: SELECT q027.region_id AS region_key, COUNT(q027.id) AS customer_rows FROM customers AS q027 GROUP BY q027.region_id ORDER BY q027.region_id

m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-08.question: For each payment status, what are the smallest and largest amounts?
m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-08.reference_sql: SELECT q028.status AS payment_state, MIN(q028.amount) AS low_amount, MAX(q028.amount) AS high_amount FROM payments AS q028 GROUP BY q028.status ORDER BY q028.status

m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-09.question: How does order value group by representative and currency?
m104s-direct-aggregation_grouping-09.reference_sql: SELECT q029.sales_rep_id AS representative_key, q029.currency AS currency_code, SUM(q029.total_amount) AS order_value FROM orders AS q029 GROUP BY q029.sales_rep_id, q029.currency ORDER BY q029.sales_rep_id, q029.currency

m104s-direct-distinct_set-00.question: Which different order currencies occur in the source?

m104s-direct-distinct_set-01.question: Which unique lifecycle states occur among orders?
m104s-direct-distinct_set-01.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT q111.status AS lifecycle FROM orders AS q111 ORDER BY q111.status

m104s-direct-distinct_set-02.question: How many different customer keys appear in each region?
m104s-direct-distinct_set-02.reference_sql: SELECT q112.region_id AS region_key, COUNT(DISTINCT q112.id) AS customer_total FROM customers AS q112 GROUP BY q112.region_id ORDER BY q112.region_id

m104s-direct-distinct_set-03.question: How many unique product keys does each order contain?
m104s-direct-distinct_set-03.reference_sql: SELECT q113.order_id AS order_key, COUNT(DISTINCT q113.product_id) AS product_total FROM order_items AS q113 GROUP BY q113.order_id ORDER BY q113.order_id

m104s-direct-distinct_set-04.question: Which unique return reasons occur, with their row totals?
m104s-direct-distinct_set-04.reference_sql: SELECT q114.reason AS reason_code, COUNT(*) AS return_rows FROM refunds AS q114 GROUP BY q114.reason ORDER BY q114.reason

m104s-direct-distinct_set-05.question: How many distinct order keys belong to each representative?
m104s-direct-distinct_set-05.reference_sql: SELECT q115.sales_rep_id AS representative_key, COUNT(DISTINCT q115.id) AS order_total FROM orders AS q115 GROUP BY q115.sales_rep_id ORDER BY q115.sales_rep_id

m104s-direct-distinct_set-06.question: Which category keys have distinct product counts?
m104s-direct-distinct_set-06.reference_sql: SELECT q116.category AS category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT q116.id) AS product_total FROM products AS q116 GROUP BY q116.category ORDER BY q116.category

m104s-direct-distinct_set-07.question: How many different orders have payments in each state?
m104s-direct-distinct_set-07.reference_sql: SELECT q117.status AS payment_state, COUNT(DISTINCT q117.order_id) AS order_total FROM payments AS q117 GROUP BY q117.status ORDER BY q117.status

m104s-direct-distinct_set-08.question: Which customer keys occur in orders without repetition?
m104s-direct-distinct_set-08.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT q118.customer_id AS customer_key FROM orders AS q118 ORDER BY q118.customer_id

m104s-direct-distinct_set-09.question: How many unique order keys use each currency?
m104s-direct-distinct_set-09.reference_sql: SELECT q119.currency AS currency_code, COUNT(DISTINCT q119.id) AS order_total FROM orders AS q119 GROUP BY q119.currency ORDER BY q119.currency

m104s-direct-filter_column-00.question: Which orders use the GBP currency code?
m104s-direct-filter_column-00.reference_sql: SELECT q040.id AS order_key, q040.total_amount AS order_value FROM orders AS q040 WHERE q040.currency = 'GBP' ORDER BY q040.id

m104s-direct-filter_column-01.question: Which customer records point to region key 2?
m104s-direct-filter_column-01.reference_sql: SELECT q041.id AS customer_key, q041.name AS customer_name FROM customers AS q041 WHERE q041.region_id = 2 ORDER BY q041.id

m104s-direct-filter_column-02.question: Which catalog items belong to the Garden category?
m104s-direct-filter_column-02.reference_sql: SELECT q042.id AS product_key, q042.name AS product_name FROM products AS q042 WHERE q042.category = 'Garden' ORDER BY q042.id

m104s-direct-filter_column-03.question: Which payments exceed 300 in stored amount?
m104s-direct-filter_column-03.reference_sql: SELECT q043.id AS payment_key, q043.amount AS payment_amount FROM payments AS q043 WHERE q043.amount > 300 ORDER BY q043.id

m104s-direct-filter_column-04.question: Which return rows are attached to order key 4?
m104s-direct-filter_column-04.reference_sql: SELECT q044.id AS return_key, q044.amount AS return_amount FROM refunds AS q044 WHERE q044.order_id = 4 ORDER BY q044.id

m104s-direct-filter_column-05.question: Which orders belong to representative key 1?

m104s-direct-filter_column-06.question: Which line rows contain at least six units?

m104s-direct-filter_column-07.question: Which region row has key 3?
m104s-direct-filter_column-07.reference_sql: SELECT q047.id AS region_key, q047.name AS region_name FROM regions AS q047 WHERE q047.id = 3 ORDER BY q047.id

m104s-direct-filter_column-08.question: Which orders carry the pending lifecycle state?
m104s-direct-filter_column-08.reference_sql: SELECT q048.id AS order_key, q048.total_amount AS order_value FROM orders AS q048 WHERE q048.status = 'pending' ORDER BY q048.id

m104s-direct-filter_column-09.question: Which payment rows are not marked failed?
m104s-direct-filter_column-09.reference_sql: SELECT q049.id AS payment_key, q049.status AS payment_state FROM payments AS q049 WHERE q049.status <> 'failed' ORDER BY q049.id

m104s-direct-filter_literal-00.question: Which orders carry the refunded lifecycle label?

m104s-direct-filter_literal-01.question: Which orders are recorded in JPY?
m104s-direct-filter_literal-01.reference_sql: SELECT q061.id AS order_key FROM orders AS q061 WHERE q061.currency = 'JPY' ORDER BY q061.id

m104s-direct-filter_literal-02.question: Which products use the Books category label?
m104s-direct-filter_literal-02.reference_sql: SELECT q062.id AS product_key FROM products AS q062 WHERE q062.category = 'Books' ORDER BY q062.id

m104s-direct-filter_literal-03.question: Which payments are marked pending?
m104s-direct-filter_literal-03.reference_sql: SELECT q063.id AS payment_key FROM payments AS q063 WHERE q063.status = 'pending' ORDER BY q063.id

m104s-direct-filter_literal-04.question: Which returns cite a late_delivery reason?
m104s-direct-filter_literal-04.reference_sql: SELECT q064.id AS return_key FROM refunds AS q064 WHERE q064.reason = 'late_delivery' ORDER BY q064.id

m104s-direct-filter_literal-05.question: Which orders were recorded on or after 2024-06-01?

m104s-direct-filter_literal-06.question: Which representatives belong to region key 4?
m104s-direct-filter_literal-06.reference_sql: SELECT q066.id AS representative_key FROM sales_representatives AS q066 WHERE q066.region_id = 4 ORDER BY q066.id

m104s-direct-filter_literal-07.question: Which line rows have a unit price of 90?
m104s-direct-filter_literal-07.reference_sql: SELECT q067.id AS line_key FROM order_items AS q067 WHERE q067.unit_price = 90 ORDER BY q067.id

m104s-direct-filter_literal-08.question: Which customer row is named Noor?
m104s-direct-filter_literal-08.reference_sql: SELECT q068.id AS customer_key FROM customers AS q068 WHERE q068.name = 'Noor' ORDER BY q068.id

m104s-direct-filter_literal-09.question: Which returns use the duplicate_charge reason?
m104s-direct-filter_literal-09.reference_sql: SELECT q069.id AS return_key, q069.amount AS return_amount FROM refunds AS q069 WHERE q069.reason = 'duplicate_charge' ORDER BY q069.id

m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-00.question: Which CAD orders have totals above 125?
m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-00.reference_sql: SELECT q050.id AS order_key, q050.total_amount AS order_value FROM orders AS q050 WHERE q050.currency = 'CAD' AND q050.total_amount > 125 ORDER BY q050.id

m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-01.question: Which catalog rows are in either Garden or Books?
m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-01.reference_sql: SELECT q051.id AS product_key, q051.category AS category_name FROM products AS q051 WHERE q051.category IN ('Garden', 'Books') ORDER BY q051.id

m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-02.question: Which orders are either pending or cancelled?
m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-02.reference_sql: SELECT q052.id AS order_key, q052.status AS lifecycle FROM orders AS q052 WHERE q052.status IN ('pending', 'cancelled') ORDER BY q052.id

m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-03.question: Which payments are neither failed nor pending?
m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-03.reference_sql: SELECT q053.id AS payment_key, q053.status AS payment_state FROM payments AS q053 WHERE q053.status NOT IN ('failed', 'pending') ORDER BY q053.id

m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-04.question: Which orders have a discount and a total over 150?
m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-04.reference_sql: SELECT q054.id AS order_key, q054.discount_amount AS discount FROM orders AS q054 WHERE q054.discount_amount > 0 AND q054.total_amount > 150 ORDER BY q054.id

m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-05.question: Which orders are cancelled or have totals below 40?
m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-05.reference_sql: SELECT q055.id AS order_key, q055.status AS lifecycle, q055.total_amount AS order_value FROM orders AS q055 WHERE q055.status = 'cancelled' OR q055.total_amount < 40 ORDER BY q055.id

m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-06.question: Which payments are positive and not settled?
m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-06.reference_sql: SELECT q056.id AS payment_key, q056.amount AS payment_amount FROM payments AS q056 WHERE q056.amount > 0 AND q056.status <> 'settled' ORDER BY q056.id

m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-07.question: Which products are outside the Books category?
m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-07.reference_sql: SELECT q057.id AS product_key, q057.category AS category_name FROM products AS q057 WHERE NOT q057.category = 'Books' ORDER BY q057.id

m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-08.question: Which returns exceed 35 or cite a damaged item?
m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-08.reference_sql: SELECT q058.id AS return_key, q058.amount AS return_amount FROM refunds AS q058 WHERE q058.amount > 35 OR q058.reason = 'damaged_item' ORDER BY q058.id

m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-09.question: Which orders have a nonzero discount in GBP?
m104s-direct-filter_operator_boolean-09.reference_sql: SELECT q059.id AS order_key, q059.discount_amount AS discount FROM orders AS q059 WHERE q059.discount_amount <> 0 AND q059.currency = 'GBP' ORDER BY q059.id

m104s-direct-formula_ratio-00.question: For every order, what remains after its discount is removed?
m104s-direct-formula_ratio-00.reference_sql: SELECT q030.id AS order_key, q030.total_amount - q030.discount_amount AS net_value FROM orders AS q030 ORDER BY q030.id

m104s-direct-formula_ratio-01.question: What extended line value results from multiplying units by price?
m104s-direct-formula_ratio-01.reference_sql: SELECT q031.id AS line_key, q031.quantity * q031.unit_price AS extended_value FROM order_items AS q031 ORDER BY q031.id

m104s-direct-formula_ratio-02.question: What amount remains from each payment after a three percent fee?
m104s-direct-formula_ratio-02.reference_sql: SELECT q032.id AS payment_key, q032.amount * 0.97 AS net_amount FROM payments AS q032 ORDER BY q032.id

m104s-direct-formula_ratio-03.question: What share of each order total is represented by its discount?
m104s-direct-formula_ratio-03.reference_sql: SELECT q033.id AS order_key, CASE WHEN q033.total_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE q033.discount_amount / q033.total_amount END AS discount_ratio FROM orders AS q033 ORDER BY q033.id

m104s-direct-formula_ratio-04.question: What fraction of its order total does each return represent?
m104s-direct-formula_ratio-04.reference_sql: SELECT q034_r.id AS return_key, CASE WHEN q034_o.total_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE q034_r.amount / q034_o.total_amount END AS return_ratio FROM refunds AS q034_r JOIN orders AS q034_o ON q034_o.id = q034_r.order_id ORDER BY q034_r.id

m104s-direct-formula_ratio-05.question: What is the difference between stored subtotal and total for each order?
m104s-direct-formula_ratio-05.reference_sql: SELECT q035.id AS order_key, q035.subtotal - q035.total_amount AS subtotal_gap FROM orders AS q035 ORDER BY q035.id

m104s-direct-formula_ratio-06.question: What is the average line value per unit within each product?
m104s-direct-formula_ratio-06.reference_sql: SELECT q036_p.id AS product_key, CASE WHEN SUM(q036_i.quantity) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(q036_i.quantity * q036_i.unit_price) / SUM(q036_i.quantity) END AS unit_value FROM products AS q036_p JOIN order_items AS q036_i ON q036_i.product_id = q036_p.id GROUP BY q036_p.id ORDER BY q036_p.id

m104s-direct-formula_ratio-07.question: What remains from every return after a two percent handling fee?
m104s-direct-formula_ratio-07.reference_sql: SELECT q037.id AS return_key, q037.amount - (q037.amount * 0.02) AS net_return FROM refunds AS q037 ORDER BY q037.id

m104s-direct-formula_ratio-08.question: What percentage of each currency's subtotal is discount value?
m104s-direct-formula_ratio-08.reference_sql: SELECT q038.currency AS currency_code, CASE WHEN SUM(q038.subtotal) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(q038.discount_amount) / SUM(q038.subtotal) * 100 END AS discount_percent FROM orders AS q038 GROUP BY q038.currency ORDER BY q038.currency

m104s-direct-formula_ratio-09.question: What is the mean order total per distinct customer for each representative?
m104s-direct-formula_ratio-09.reference_sql: SELECT q039.sales_rep_id AS representative_key, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT q039.customer_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(q039.total_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT q039.customer_id) END AS mean_customer_value FROM orders AS q039 GROUP BY q039.sales_rep_id ORDER BY q039.sales_rep_id

m104s-direct-join_grain-00.question: At the account level, what total order value belongs to each account?
m104s-direct-join_grain-00.reference_sql: SELECT q010_c.id AS account_key, SUM(q010_o.total_amount) AS account_value FROM customers AS q010_c JOIN orders AS q010_o ON q010_o.customer_id = q010_c.id GROUP BY q010_c.id ORDER BY q010_c.id

m104s-direct-join_grain-01.question: At product level, how many units are represented by its order lines?
m104s-direct-join_grain-01.reference_sql: SELECT q011_p.id AS product_key, SUM(q011_i.quantity) AS unit_total FROM products AS q011_p JOIN order_items AS q011_i ON q011_i.product_id = q011_p.id GROUP BY q011_p.id ORDER BY q011_p.id

m104s-direct-join_grain-02.question: For each sales representative, how many order rows are assigned?
m104s-direct-join_grain-02.reference_sql: SELECT q012_s.id AS representative_key, COUNT(q012_o.id) AS order_total FROM sales_representatives AS q012_s JOIN orders AS q012_o ON q012_o.sales_rep_id = q012_s.id GROUP BY q012_s.id ORDER BY q012_s.id

m104s-direct-join_grain-03.question: At order level, what payment amount is attached to each order?
m104s-direct-join_grain-03.reference_sql: SELECT q013_o.id AS order_key, SUM(q013_p.amount) AS paid_total FROM orders AS q013_o JOIN payments AS q013_p ON q013_p.order_id = q013_o.id GROUP BY q013_o.id ORDER BY q013_o.id

m104s-direct-join_grain-04.question: At region level, how many customer records connect to each region?
m104s-direct-join_grain-04.reference_sql: SELECT q014_r.id AS region_key, COUNT(q014_c.id) AS account_total FROM regions AS q014_r JOIN customers AS q014_c ON q014_c.region_id = q014_r.id GROUP BY q014_r.id ORDER BY q014_r.id

m104s-direct-join_grain-05.question: At order level, what refund amount is connected to each order?
m104s-direct-join_grain-05.reference_sql: SELECT q015_o.id AS order_key, SUM(q015_r.amount) AS return_total FROM orders AS q015_o JOIN refunds AS q015_r ON q015_r.order_id = q015_o.id GROUP BY q015_o.id ORDER BY q015_o.id

m104s-direct-join_grain-06.question: Which product categories accumulate quantity through their line records?
m104s-direct-join_grain-06.reference_sql: SELECT q016_p.category AS category_name, SUM(q016_i.quantity) AS unit_total FROM products AS q016_p JOIN order_items AS q016_i ON q016_i.product_id = q016_p.id GROUP BY q016_p.category ORDER BY q016_p.category

m104s-direct-join_grain-07.question: Which representative is paired with which region label?
m104s-direct-join_grain-07.reference_sql: SELECT q017_s.name AS representative_name, q017_r.name AS region_name FROM sales_representatives AS q017_s JOIN regions AS q017_r ON q017_r.id = q017_s.region_id ORDER BY q017_s.name

m104s-direct-join_grain-08.question: For each account, how many different catalog products appear in its orders?
m104s-direct-join_grain-08.reference_sql: SELECT q018_c.id AS account_key, COUNT(DISTINCT q018_i.product_id) AS product_total FROM customers AS q018_c JOIN orders AS q018_o ON q018_o.customer_id = q018_c.id JOIN order_items AS q018_i ON q018_i.order_id = q018_o.id GROUP BY q018_c.id ORDER BY q018_c.id

m104s-direct-join_grain-09.question: At region level, what payment value is reached through its accounts and orders?
m104s-direct-join_grain-09.reference_sql: SELECT q019_r.id AS region_key, SUM(q019_p.amount) AS payment_total FROM regions AS q019_r JOIN customers AS q019_c ON q019_c.region_id = q019_r.id JOIN orders AS q019_o ON q019_o.customer_id = q019_c.id JOIN payments AS q019_p ON q019_p.order_id = q019_o.id GROUP BY q019_r.id ORDER BY q019_r.id

m104s-direct-order_topn-00.question: Which four orders have the largest stored totals?
m104s-direct-order_topn-00.reference_sql: SELECT q100.id AS order_key, q100.total_amount AS order_value FROM orders AS q100 ORDER BY q100.total_amount DESC LIMIT 4

m104s-direct-order_topn-01.question: Which seven products come first by ascending label?

m104s-direct-order_topn-02.question: Which six payments have the greatest amounts?
m104s-direct-order_topn-02.reference_sql: SELECT q102.id AS payment_key, q102.amount AS payment_amount FROM payments AS q102 ORDER BY q102.amount DESC LIMIT 6

m104s-direct-order_topn-03.question: Which three returns have the highest values?
m104s-direct-order_topn-03.reference_sql: SELECT q103.id AS return_key, q103.amount AS return_amount FROM refunds AS q103 ORDER BY q103.amount DESC LIMIT 3

m104s-direct-order_topn-04.question: Which eight customers come first in identifier order?
m104s-direct-order_topn-04.reference_sql: SELECT q104.id AS customer_key, q104.name AS customer_name FROM customers AS q104 ORDER BY q104.id ASC LIMIT 8

m104s-direct-order_topn-05.question: Which four categories have the greatest mean product price?
m104s-direct-order_topn-05.reference_sql: SELECT q105.category AS category_name, AVG(q105.unit_price) AS mean_price FROM products AS q105 GROUP BY q105.category ORDER BY mean_price DESC LIMIT 4

m104s-direct-order_topn-06.question: Which six representatives have the most orders?

m104s-direct-order_topn-07.question: Which five orders are earliest by their stored time?
m104s-direct-order_topn-07.reference_sql: SELECT q107.id AS order_key, q107.ordered_at AS order_time FROM orders AS q107 ORDER BY q107.ordered_at ASC LIMIT 5

m104s-direct-order_topn-08.question: Which five products have the lowest listed prices?
m104s-direct-order_topn-08.reference_sql: SELECT q108.id AS product_key, q108.unit_price AS listed_price FROM products AS q108 ORDER BY q108.unit_price ASC LIMIT 5

m104s-direct-order_topn-09.question: Which three payment states have the largest total value?
m104s-direct-order_topn-09.reference_sql: SELECT q109.status AS payment_state, SUM(q109.amount) AS payment_value FROM payments AS q109 GROUP BY q109.status ORDER BY payment_value DESC LIMIT 3

m104s-direct-projection_result_shape-00.question: Return the order reference with its lifecycle text as two named columns.
m104s-direct-projection_result_shape-00.reference_sql: SELECT q090.order_number AS order_ref, q090.status AS lifecycle_text FROM orders AS q090 ORDER BY q090.order_number

m104s-direct-projection_result_shape-01.question: Show a product label and its price increased by a fixed service amount.

m104s-direct-projection_result_shape-02.question: Return exactly a region key and region label for each region.

m104s-direct-projection_result_shape-03.question: Project the customer label with its order representative key.
m104s-direct-projection_result_shape-03.reference_sql: SELECT q093.name AS customer_label, q093.sales_rep_id AS representative_key FROM customers AS q093 ORDER BY q093.name

m104s-direct-projection_result_shape-04.question: Return payment state and amount as the result pair.

m104s-direct-projection_result_shape-05.question: Project a return reason and value under readable names.

m104s-direct-schema_source_grounding-04.question: Which return records identify the associated order and stated reason?

m104s-direct-temporal-03.question: Which returns were recorded during 2023?
